summary: Project supported replicated planning events through the existing planning rebuild instead of triggering a whole-store replay.

replay.detail: Known planning-session events use the existing canonical planning-table rebuild during incremental projection. Unrelated projections are not rebuilt. Malformed operation metadata and unknown planning kinds retain their existing replay guards.

schema.detail: No schema, durable claim or projection table changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or graph digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes or coordinated member upgrade required. The resulting canonical projection is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No production interruption measured. Activating the new binary uses the ordinary managed daemon replacement path.

manual.detail: No state repair, queue deletion or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes or new rollback restrictions. Older binaries retain the unnecessary full-replay trigger.
